packageRules.description: github-actions: pin SHAs and auto-merge after the 7-day quarantine. Per-manager automerge scope ensures a future manager activation (e.g. npm via a new package.json) does NOT inherit automerge.

Self-reference to local composite action pinned by SHA. Renovate's github-actions manager treats `owner/repo/path@sha` uniformly, so pinDigests above covers the bump path. This rule exists to document intent and to ensure the self-reference is not accidentally excluded by a future matcher.

Nix install URL: scoped automerge for the same reason as github-actions. The custom manager below extracts the version from the install_url string. matchDepNames is narrowed to 'nix' so the other custom-regex managers in this file (cachix/git-hooks.nix, NixOS/nixpkgs) do NOT inherit automerge — those have wide blast radius (flake-eval-time evaluation, lib drift, package version refresh) and must be reviewed manually.

customManagers.description: cachix/git-hooks.nix master HEAD tracker. Uses git-refs datasource because that repo publishes 0 GitHub releases and 0 tags — master HEAD is the only upstream-truth signal. Renovate opens a PR whenever master advances; runs through the global 7-day minimumReleaseAge quarantine. Stays manual-merge by design (see matchDepNames narrow above). REVIEWER NOTE: this manager only substitutes the SHA in flake.nix; flake.lock will be stale until you run `nix flake update --update-input pre-commit-hooks` locally and push the refresh — see docs/architecture/flake-input-bumps.md for the full runbook.

NixOS/nixpkgs stable branch tracker. Captures the YY.MM suffix of the nixos-YY.MM branch in flake.nix and watches NixOS/nixpkgs tags for new YY.MM tags (versioningTemplate restricts to MAJOR.MINOR form). NixOS tags only at GA, so this naturally proposes the next stable branch when it ships. Stays manual-merge by design (see matchDepNames narrow above) because nixpkgs branch bumps have wide blast radius. REVIEWER NOTE: this manager only substitutes the branch name in flake.nix; flake.lock will be stale and CI will fail until you run `nix flake update --update-input nixpkgs` locally and push the refresh. Expect downstream side-effects (prettier, mkdocs-macros strictness, zizmor major version, image base-layer rotation) — see docs/architecture/flake-input-bumps.md for the full runbook.

SchemaStore master HEAD tracker for the JSON Schema URLs consumed by scripts/check-jsonschema.sh. Same shape as the cachix/git-hooks.nix manager — SchemaStore publishes 0 releases and 0 tags, master HEAD is the only upstream-truth signal. Renovate opens a PR whenever master advances; the global 7-day minimumReleaseAge applies. Not in any matchDepNames automerge narrow, so it stays manual-merge.
